deny.reason: \restylefloat{figure} (ruled, boxed) sends every figure \caption to float.sty's \float@caption, which needs \@fs@capt, set only inside float.sty's own figure: a wrapfigure's caption stopped at 'Undefined control sequence' (\@fs@capt). A way conflict holds for every preset, so plain is filed apart too
the same for a sidewaysfigure's caption (\float@caption, \@fs@capt undefined)

the same for sidecap's SCfigure (fig.floatrow's sidecap presets), whose \caption reaches float.sty's \float@caption outside float.sty's figure: 'Undefined control sequence' in \float@caption (\@fs@capt); its floatrow presets load floatrow, which refuses float anyway
